entries.comment: Summary: DNAS cmd 0xC7 bypassed in deliver path; GetServerList cmd 0x97 mapped (ctx ptr/server count/default id); MUIS hostname identified for DNS redirect; FTScore/ZDB decrypt pipeline mapped through AES_CBC_Core with session-derived key/IV and outer pre-AES transform

entries.name: Seal Pos Y
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x20. World position Y (float). = -148.9 this session.

entries.name: Seal Pos Z
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x24. World position Z (float). = 857.1 this session.

entries.name: Seal Body Ptr
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x28. Ptr to CZSealBody sub-object. = 0x00EDDА80 this session.

entries.name: Seal Health
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x54. Health as normalized float (0.0=dead, 1.0=full). = 1.0 this session.

entries.name: Seal Team ID
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x58. Team ID (int). 0=SEALs, 1=Terrorists. = 0 this session.

entries.name: Seal Weapon Array Ptr
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x180. Ptr to weapon instance array (22 slots, each 0x2C bytes). = 0x00EE5590 this session.

entries.name: Seal Weapon Slot Table Ptr
entries.comment: Seal Entity +0x1D4. Ptr to weapon slot pointer table (25 entries). = 0x00EE5D00 this session.

entries.name: Seal Weapon Array
entries.comment: Weapon instance array. 22 entries each 0x2C bytes. Ptrs point into animation/model data at 0x01797FF0+. This session. Each slot: +0x00=modelDataPtr, +0x04=count1, +0x08=count2.

entries.name: Seal Weapon Slot Table
entries.comment: Weapon slot pointer table. 25 entries (4 bytes each). Each ptr -> CZFTSWeapon slot object with ammo/state. slot[0]=0x00EE5D90, slot[2]=0x00EE5E50, etc. This session addr.

entries.name: gZDBBase
entries.comment: ZDB file base loaded into EE RAM. Header: FC 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 11 22 89 41 01 00 00 00 / 00 00 00 00 72 30 30 30 31 (r0001). DNAS blob starts at EE+0x1E0 = 0x01E7EC30. Encrypted FTScore payload at EE+0x3E0 = 0x01E7EE30.

entries.name: gAESCtx_IV
entries.comment: AES-CBC context: first 16 bytes = IV / chain state. Initialized to real IV before first chunk, updated to last CT block after each AES call (CBC chaining). Captured: 84 C2 7C 37 D9 07 C2 C1 8E 32 8F 18 7F 44 CF 6A

entries.name: gAESCtx_Key
entries.comment: AES-CBC context: bytes 16-31 = AES-128 key (constant across all chunks of one section). Captured: 0D EE 71 86 A4 C4 54 63 00 03 23 A6 86 34 C9 0B. Key source: IOP-side DNAS decryption, NOT raw ZDB bytes.

entries.name: gAESCiphertextBuf
entries.comment: AES ciphertext input buffer. 128 bytes per chunk. SOURCE UNKNOWN - bytes do NOT appear in ZDB file or IOP RAM verbatim. Possibly transformed by ZDBSectionDecrypt (0x5412A0) stream reader before passing to AES. First block captured: F2 8B 0F 90 A5 DA 9C A0 05 51 49 F6 E4 85 18 16

entries.name: gDNASBlob
entries.comment: DNAS blob in EE RAM. 0x300 bytes (offset 0x1E0 from gZDBBase). Starts: 83 F4 06 0A 3D E2 BA E4... Contains DNAS authentication data read by ReadSeedFromDNAS (0x53D438) to extract FTScore seed 0x02291104.

entries.name: gMediusSessionKey
entries.comment: AES-128 session key (16 bytes). Medius SDK session key, provisioned by DNAS server during auth. Changes every boot/reconnect. Boot-time value: 875f14c4a8c3a28c18616d00903e6bb1. Followed at +0x10 by 16-byte IV.

entries.name: gAESDecryptOutput
entries.comment: AES-128 CBC decryption output buffer. 128 bytes per chunk. Written by AES_CBC_Core (0x53FC60), called from FTScoreChunkDecryptor (0x541658) ~880 times. After all chunks decrypted, complete MWo3 appears at gMWo3FTScoreOutput (0x1E7000). First chunk output: E4 08 94 FD AF 50 2A 36...
